page.title: Vantro Sports app for iPhone and Android
page.description: Download the official Vantro app. Live odds, same-game multis and PayID withdrawals. Free. 18+.

hero.title: The official Vantro app for Australia
hero.subtitle: Bet on footy, cricket and racing, build same-game multis and withdraw to PayID, all from your phone.

screens.caption: PayID withdrawals in about an hour

items.title: Instant odds updates
items.text: Prices refresh in real time during play, with alerts when they move.

items.title: Live streaming
items.text: Watch selected matches in the app while you bet in-play.

items.title: Face ID log-in
items.text: Log in with Face ID or your fingerprint instead of a password.

items.title: Limits in two taps
items.text: Set deposit limits or take a break from the account screen.

items.a: Yes. The app is free to download from the App Store and Google Play.
iPhone with iOS 15 or later, and Android phones with Android 8.0 or later.

items.q: How do I know I have the official app?
items.a: Use the App Store and Google Play links on this page. The app is published by Vantro Digital Pty Ltd, the licensed operator.

items.q: Do I need a new account for the app?
items.a: No. Log in with your existing Vantro account, or create one in the app.

items.q: How do I set limits in the app?
items.a: Open Account, then Responsible gambling, to set deposit limits or take a break. You can also use BetStop at betstop.gov.au.

final.title: Get the Vantro app
final.text: Free on iPhone and Android. 18+ only.
